title: Elron Club Public Rentals
description: Search Elron Club furnished apartments, availability, prices, details, and rental applications.
summary: Search Elron Club furnished apartments, availability, prices, details, and rental applications.
offersHint: Search Elron Club furnished apartments, availability, prices, details, and rental applications. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://elron.club/api/agent/public/mcp

toolsPreview.name: waitlist.subscribe
toolsPreview.description: Activate newsletter updates for one canonical Elron region immediately after the customer explicitly requests them. An explicit customer request may reverse a previous opt-out without a confirmation email; automated inquiry and staff flows cannot override customer opt-outs.

toolsPreview.name: waitlist.unsubscribe
toolsPreview.description: Use an opaque unsubscribe token from an Elron marketing email to stop every waitlist marketing update.

toolsPreview.name: rentals.search
toolsPreview.description: Return a compact, actionable shortlist of published furnished apartments by location, availability, capacity, rooms, duration, and monthly rent. Defaults to 10 available or upcoming rentals; call rentals.get for complete details.

toolsPreview.name: rentals.get
toolsPreview.description: Return localized customer-safe apartment details, verified availability, duration pricing, deposit, included services, terms, eligibility, media, and inquiry/application links.

toolsPreview.name: rentals.check_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check the current published availability state and earliest date for one rental. This does not create a hold or reservation.

toolsPreview.name: rentals.get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Return current published monthly pricing by supported duration, parking, deposit, inclusions, payment method, and minimum-stay terms. Pricing is informational until a quote or hold is issued.

toolsPreview.name: applications.start
toolsPreview.description: Create or reuse a duplicate-safe applicant workspace for one published rental. Requires explicit current privacy consent and an idempotency key. Email verification is sent to the applicant; the tool never returns the verification URL.

toolsPreview.name: applications.get_status
toolsPreview.description: Read the privacy-minimized status and next actions for one scoped application session token.

toolsPreview.name: applications.update
toolsPreview.description: Update bounded applicant, tenancy, and billing data for one email-verified session using its exact current version and a durable idempotency key.

toolsPreview.name: applications.create_document_upload
toolsPreview.description: Create a 15-minute, exact-size and exact-content-type signed upload form for one email-verified application at its exact current version.

toolsPreview.name: applications.complete_document_upload
toolsPreview.description: Verify the uploaded object, content signature, session ownership, expiry, and exact application version before creating the protected document record.

toolsPreview.name: applications.upload_document
toolsPreview.description: Upload one bounded PDF, JPEG, or PNG identity or company-registry document to an email-verified application using its exact version and a durable idempotency key.

toolsPreview.name: applications.submit
toolsPreview.description: Submit one complete email-verified application for review using its exact version, explicit current credit-check and truth-confirmation consent, and a durable idempotency key.

toolsPreview.name: viewings.get_status
toolsPreview.description: Read customer-safe viewing proposals and confirmed viewing state for one email-verified application session.

toolsPreview.name: viewings.propose_availability
toolsPreview.description: Propose one to five bounded future viewing slots from an email-verified application at its exact version using a durable idempotency key.

toolsPreview.name: viewings.respond_to_proposal
toolsPreview.description: Accept or decline one pending Elron Club proposal with explicit confirmation, an exact application version, and a durable idempotency key. Acceptance may send the existing viewing confirmation communication.

toolsPreview.name: quotes.create
toolsPreview.description: Snapshot customer-safe approved request terms into a 24-hour quote. The application must be submitted, internally approved, due-diligence positive, and solvency passed. This does not hold inventory.

toolsPreview.name: quotes.get
toolsPreview.description: Read one privacy-minimized quote and its live expiry/availability-hold state using the application session that owns it.

toolsPreview.name: quotes.accept
toolsPreview.description: With explicit customer confirmation, accept one exact active quote and atomically claim a 30-minute request-owned availability hold. This does not create or sign a contract and does not authorize payment.

toolsPreview.name: reservations.get_status
toolsPreview.description: Read privacy-minimized hold, contract, signature, payment, reservation, or confirmation state for one application session.

toolsPreview.name: contracts.get_signing_link
toolsPreview.description: Return a secure signing URL only when the active signer invitation email matches the email-verified application session. Human verification, review, and signature remain in the signing flow.

toolsPreview.name: payments.get_status
toolsPreview.description: Return due and received payment truth for the scoped application. An approved human-action URL is returned only from an exact, unexpired provider session; no authorization URL is fabricated.

toolsPreview.name: bookings.get_confirmation
toolsPreview.description: Return a privacy-minimized booking confirmation only after the request has converted into the authoritative Stay workflow.
